title: feat(nm2axx): axis-cover of M and O at t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Two-axis opposite seed, x-probes, axis-cover: the probe-direction discriminator. On one fixed seed the three probe frames give three different cover verdicts - z: hold/hold, y: hold/fail, x: fail/fail - establishing a genuine directional anisotropy of the readout on an isotropic cubic host. Also shows forall-perp HOLDs at A where cover FAILs.
